selectionReason: Highest development scenario-win total, fewer severe losses, and positive observed opening-entropy changes in the proposed mixture.
unit: One native personality chosen for the entire own draft, never changed between turns.

validation.bootstrap: 10000 paired draft-cluster resamples stratified by faction and opponent policy; no scenario-level independent resampling.
validation.successMargin: One-sided 95% lower bound on modeled mixed-minus-Standard success >= -0.005.
validation.severeLossMargin: One-sided 95% upper bound on modeled mixed-minus-Standard severe-loss frequency <= 0.005.
validation.diversity: Observed first-pick and first-ban mixture entropy must not decline, at least one must increase, and one-sided 95% lower bound on their summed change must be >= 0.
validation.limits: Expected mixture outcomes computed from paired complete style drafts, not observed mixed-policy PvP matches. Default own items and native draft-fit strategy, not the production optimizer. Passing these checks permits further integration testing, not a proven real-world win-rate claim.
